purpose: Exploratory capacity check (thingsboard, k1): does the platform exceed 500 msg/s? Warm-up 120 s at 50, then 3-minute constant-rate steps; judged offline by benchctl explore with the rule declared in docs/exploratory-capacity.md. 1000 devices round-robin so one device's messages are >= 1 s apart at 1000 msg/s (ThingsBoard keys telemetry by device and arrival ms). Not a paper result.
deviations: Outbound delivery to the Go sink on ramonavm1 configured for the measurement (scripts/outbound.sh); setup, not tuning.
1000 devices round-robin (one device's messages >= 1 s apart at 1000 msg/s).

ThingsBoard container memory raised for the exploratory runs (user decision 2026-10-22, D11): tb-core and tb-rule-engine 1536m, tb-http-transport 768m (TB_CORE_MEM / TB_RULE_ENGINE_MEM / TB_HTTP_TRANSPORT_MEM); JVM heap flags unchanged (-Xmx512m). At 1 GB, tb-core was OOM-killed during device provisioning (EXPL-tb-k4, 09:41 UTC).
